todos.content: Look up Shopify ops: productBundleCreate, productBundleUpdate, discountCodeBasicCreate, discountCodeBxgyCreate, discountCodeBasicUpdate, discountCodeBxgyUpdate, productVariant
Look up Storefront ops: cartLinesAdd, cartDiscountCodesUpdate

consumes: POST /admin/bundles/create requestShape: bundle_type, components, discount_kind, flexible_pick_count, tiers, title
PUT /admin/bundles/update requestShape: bundle_id, bundle_type, components, discount_kind, enabled, flexible_pick_count, tiers, title
[create-shopify-bundle-product/productBundleCreate] consumes: bundle title, component product ids, option selections, quantities
[provision-tier-discount-codes/discountCodeBasicCreate] consumes: discount kind, value, item scope
[provision-tier-discount-codes/discountCodeBxgyCreate] consumes: buy quantity, get quantity, item scope
[update-shopify-bundle-product/productBundleUpdate] consumes: shopify bundle product external id, updated component data
[sync-tier-discount-codes/discountCodeBasicUpdate] consumes: discount node id, updated value
[sync-tier-discount-codes/discountCodeBxgyUpdate] consumes: discount node id, updated buy/get quantities
produces: GET /admin/bundles responseShape: bundles, next_cursor, total_count
POST /admin/bundles/create responseShape: bundle_id, status, warnings
PUT /admin/bundles/update responseShape: bundle_id, status, warnings
POST /admin/bundles/toggle responseShape: errors, updated_count
GET /admin/bundles/detail responseShape: bundle, purchase_count
[create-shopify-bundle-product/productBundleCreate] produces: shopify bundle product node id and product external id
[provision-tier-discount-codes/discountCodeBasicCreate] produces: discount code node id and code string for percentage and flat-amount tiers
[provision-tier-discount-codes/discountCodeBxgyCreate] produces: discount code node id and code string for buy-x-get-y tiers
[update-shopify-bundle-product/productBundleUpdate] produces: updated bundle product node id
[sync-tier-discount-codes/discountCodeBasicUpdate] produces: updated code discount node for percentage and flat-amount tiers
[sync-tier-discount-codes/discountCodeBxgyUpdate] produces: updated code discount node for buy-x-get-y tiers
[resolve-variant-prices/productVariant] produces: variant price and availability
do_not: pass a literal/placeholder GID (e.g. 'gid://shopify/Product/0') to any Shopify op — fail-fast instead
call a bound op only to discard its returned id — every produces above must be persisted or threaded forward
provision Shopify side-effects outside the DB transaction without a rollback path

consumes: POST /widget/bundle/add-to-cart requestShape: bundle_id, cart_external_id, item_count, selected_variant_external_ids
[add-bundle-to-cart/cartLinesAdd] consumes: cart external id, variant merchandise ids and quantities
[add-bundle-to-cart/cartDiscountCodesUpdate] consumes: cart external id, tier discount code string from previous step
produces: GET /widget/bundles responseShape: bundles, next_cursor, total_count
POST /widget/bundle/add-to-cart responseShape: cart_external_id, discount_code, discounted_total, warnings
POST /widget/bundle/preview-total responseShape: discount_amount, discounted_total, original_total, tier_label
[add-bundle-to-cart/cartLinesAdd] produces: updated cart with line ids
[add-bundle-to-cart/cartDiscountCodesUpdate] produces: cart with applied discount code
for every member/row this route returns: include resolved `live.<field>` for any reference the storefront will pass to cartCreate
do_not: fall back from a resolved live.<field> to the raw DB column it shadows (e.g. `?? member.product_external_id`)
accept caller-supplied ids without validating shape (variant ids are numeric strings; merchandise GIDs go to ProductVariant, not Product)

implements: a product or its variants are updated or removed in the catalog
a product is permanently deleted from the catalog
consumes: [products/update] event: a product or its variants are updated or removed in the catalog
[products/delete] event: a product is permanently deleted from the catalog
produces: idempotent DB writes per the capability each trigger drives
ON CONFLICT on every dedup-keyed insert (per persistence keyedBy)
do_not: early-return when a declared signalField is empty (silently disables the trigger)
read an undeclared payload field (paths above are the contract)
ignore a declared payloadBinding — every signalField above must be read at least once
